name: apply_workspace_context_update
purpose: Writes an owner-approved patch to the workspace executive context (mandate, executive roles, portfolio policies, delivery settings, financial settings) with validation and an audit event.
useWhen: The owner approved a specific patch (often draft.proposedPatch from draft_workspace_operating_model or draft_workspace_routing_policy) and asked you to apply it
The owner told you who holds an executive role (portfolio-owner, operations-lead, finance-owner, routing-owner) and asked you to record it
avoidWhen: You only want to see a proposal -> draft_workspace_operating_model / draft_workspace_routing_policy
Changing which project owns a domain or capability -> update_project routingProfile
Roadmap items or capability records -> roadmap change tools / create_workspace_capability
The owner has not approved the exact patch: present it and wait

inputs.notes: Firestore document ID.
Non-empty text; stored in the audit trail.

inputs.source: draft_workspace_operating_model / draft_workspace_routing_policy -> draft.proposedPatch.patch, or built from the owner's instructions
inputs.notes: Object touching at least one of: mandate{mission, operatingModel, strategicIntent, successCriteria[]}, governance{assignmentsToAdd[{role, userId}], assignmentsToRemove[{role, userId}], assignments[{role, userId}], missingRoles[], escalationPolicy, decisionPolicy}, portfolio{domains[], capabilities[], systems[], priorityRules[], routingPolicySummary}, delivery{curationSlaHours >= 0, releasePolicy, operationalCadence}, financial{currency ISO 4217, hourlyRateDefault >= 0, budgetPolicy}. role enum: workspace-owner|portfolio-owner|operations-lead|finance-owner|routing-owner. userId from list_workspace_members -> userId.

inputs.source: constant true, only after the owner explicitly approved this exact patch
inputs.notes: Required for sensitive fields (see gotchas); otherwise the call fails.

inputs.source: list_workspace_members -> userId of the owner who requested it
inputs.notes: Defaults to the caller; stored as assignedBy on new role assignments.

preconditions: Caller is the workspace owner or an admin member
The owner explicitly approved the exact patch (GOV-MAX); financial fields are always the owner's decision
API key access: not exposed to OAuth connectors
idempotency: not idempotent: no key; last writer wins; re-read executiveContext.metadata.lastReviewedAt before any retry
returns: {workspace, executiveContext (the new stored context), review{sensitivity safe|sensitive, requiresHumanConfirmation, touchedAreas[]}, validationIssues[], changedFields[], auditEventId, appliedAt}

errors.when: You do not have permission to update this workspace executive context
errors.fix: Caller is not owner/admin. Hand the approved patch to the owner; do not look for another credential.

errors.when: Sensitive workspace executive context changes require human confirmation
errors.fix: Show the patch to the owner; retry with confirmSensitiveChanges=true only after explicit approval.

errors.when: Workspace executive context patch is invalid
errors.fix: Details are not returned over MCP. Check: reason not empty, patch has at least one of mandate/governance/portfolio/delivery/financial, every role is in the enum and every userId is a non-empty string.

errors.when: Workspace executive context <field> must be an array of strings / must be a non-negative number
errors.fix: Send arrays of strings for list fields and numbers >= 0 for curationSlaHours and hourlyRateDefault.

errors.when: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'trim')
errors.fix: An assignment is missing role or userId; send both as strings.

errors.when: Workspace executive context not found
errors.fix: Re-check workspaceId with list_workspaces.

errors.when: -32003 This API key is not allowed to call MCP tool
errors.fix: The key's access profile excludes this write tool; ask the owner. Never create or swap keys yourself.

gotchas.text: Sensitive (needs confirmSensitiveChanges=true): any governance assignment change, decisionPolicy, escalationPolicy, priorityRules, routingPolicySummary, releasePolicy and any financial field.
Text and number fields: null does NOT clear a value (keeps the current one, despite the schema note on currency); an empty string clears it, and a derived default may then reappear on read.
Array fields (successCriteria, domains, capabilities, systems, priorityRules) REPLACE the stored list.
governance.assignments only upserts by role and never removes; remove with assignmentsToRemove (role AND userId must match the current holder).
A missing-role blocker clears only by assigning the role; a missingRoles override does not stick.
userId is not checked against membership.
Reads may show the old context for about 5 s (read cache).
Re-run generate_workspace_readiness_report after every apply.

Each call writes the WHOLE context, computed from a read model that may be up to 5 s old, and appends a new audit event: a concurrent change or two applies in a row can revert fields. Re-read get_workspace_executive_context (metadata.lastReviewedAt) before any retry or second apply.

Choosing which draft to generate (sourceGapIds of the drafts refer to these gap ids)

API key access: this tool is not exposed to OAuth connectors
returns: {workspace, executiveContext, generatedAt, items[{id (e.g. 'missing-governance-role:finance-owner', 'unowned-domain:<name>'), workspaceId, gapType missing-governance-role|missing-mandate|missing-priority-policy|missing-routing-policy|missing-financial-context|unowned-domain|unowned-capability|inconsistent-project-alignment, severity low|medium|high|critical, title, detail, evidence[], suggestedAction, requiresHumanConfirmation}]}

gotchas.text: title, detail and suggestedAction are in Portuguese; evidence is in English.
Severity: missing workspace-owner or portfolio-owner = critical, other missing roles = high, unowned domain/capability = high, project routing profile pointing to another workspace = critical.
All gaps except missing mission have requiresHumanConfirmation=true: report them to the owner, do not fix silently.

Fix map: missing-governance-role -> apply_workspace_context_update governance.assignmentsToAdd (owner approval); missing-mandate -> mandate.mission; missing-priority-policy/missing-routing-policy -> draft_workspace_routing_policy; missing-financial-context -> financial.currency (owner-only) or harmonize project currencies; unowned-domain/capability and inconsistent-project-alignment -> update_project routingProfile.
items is empty when the context cannot be built.
Same server cost as get_workspace_read_model.

name: preview_workspace_routing
purpose: Ranks which projects of the workspace should receive an intake entry or an ad hoc report, with scores, signals and an outcome, without saving anything.
useWhen: Before review_workspace_routing, to choose the project(s) and show the options to the user
Someone describes a bug or request and you need to suggest which project owns it (ad hoc title + description, no intake entry needed)
avoidWhen: Recording the decision or creating project entries -> review_workspace_routing
The target project is already known -> create_operational_entry in that project
Changing the routing policy -> draft_workspace_routing_policy

inputs.notes: Firestore document ID.

inputs.source: get_protocol -> intakeEntryId (or user, from the web intake screen)
inputs.notes: If given, its title/description/technicalContext/affectedArea are used unless you override them.
Required together with description when no intakeEntryId.
Required together with title when no intakeEntryId.
Free text; improves matching.
Free text, e.g. module or screen name.
Number of candidates, 1-10, default 5.

preconditions: Caller is the workspace owner or an active workspace member
API key access: not exposed to OAuth connectors
returns: {workspaceId, intakeEntryId|null, outcome single-project|multi-project|ambiguous|no-match, reasonCode out_of_portfolio_scope|insufficient_routing_evidence|null, confidence 0-1, rationale, candidates[{projectId, projectName, projectKey, score, confidence, rationale, routingProfileCompleteness, signals{ownershipScore, semanticScore, dependencyScore, historicalScore, matchedTerms[], excludedTerms[]}}], generatedAt}

errors.when: Workspace routing preview requires title and description or a valid intake entry
errors.fix: Pass both title and description, or a valid intakeEntryId.

errors.when: Workspace intake entry not found
errors.fix: Get intakeEntryId from get_protocol(protocolCode) or ask the user.

errors.when: You do not have access to this workspace
errors.fix: Check workspaceId; the caller must be a workspace member.

gotchas.text: Deterministic keyword scoring (ownership 45%, semantic 30%, dependency 15%, routing history 10%); no AI call, nothing saved.
Top score < 0.35 = no-match; a close second (>= 0.5 and within 0.1) = ambiguous; both high (>= 0.72 and >= 0.64, within 0.06) = multi-project.
Ambiguous, multi-project and no-match need a human decision.
Quality depends on project routing profiles (update_project routingProfile).
Archived projects and projects of other workspaces are never candidates.
The CLI only supports intake mode (no ad hoc title/description).

name: record_workspace_delivery_receipt
purpose: Records that a reply to a protocol requester (e.g. a WhatsApp intake) is pending, was sent or failed, and updates the intake's delivery status and the protocol's public status; it does not send anything.
useWhen: You or the integration actually attempted to deliver the protocol reply to the requester and must log the outcome
A delivery failed and the failure must be visible in the protocol lineage
avoidWhen: Sending the message itself: use the messaging channel's own tool; this tool only logs
Attaching evidence files to the protocol -> create_protocol_evidence_attachment
Reading delivery history -> get_protocol / get_protocol_lineage

inputs.notes: Firestore document ID.

inputs.source: get_protocol -> intakeEntryId (or user, from the web intake screen)
inputs.notes: The intake entry must carry a protocol.
enum pending|sent|failed.

inputs.source: user (protocol code given to the requester) or get_protocol -> protocolCode
inputs.notes: Defaults to the intake's protocol; uppercased; must match ^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9-]{4,80}$ and equal the intake's protocol.
Default 'whatsapp'.
A hash reference, never a raw phone number or name. Defaults to the intake requester's externalRefHash.
ISO 8601; default now.
ISO 8601; default now when status=sent, else null.
For status=failed. Never include tokens or secrets.

preconditions: Caller is the workspace owner or an active member (any role)
The intake entry exists and has a protocol (WhatsApp/EvolutionAPI intake)
The delivery attempt really happened; never record 'sent' for a message nobody sent
API key access: not exposed to OAuth connectors
returns: {id (receipt id), workspaceId, intakeEntryId, protocolCode, channel, recipientRefHash, status, attemptedAt, sentAt, errorMessage, createdAt}

errors.when: Workspace intake entry not found
errors.fix: Get the right intakeEntryId from get_protocol(protocolCode) -> intakeEntryId.

errors.when: Protocol code is invalid
errors.fix: The intake has no protocol and none was passed, or the code is malformed; pass the exact code from get_protocol.

errors.when: Delivery protocol does not match intake protocol
errors.fix: Use the protocolCode of this intake entry (get_protocol -> protocolCode) or omit it.

errors.when: Delivery status is invalid
errors.fix: Use pending, sent or failed.

errors.when: Delivery recipientRefHash is required
errors.fix: The intake has no requester hash; pass recipientRefHash (a hash, not a phone number).

errors.when: You do not have access to this workspace
errors.fix: Check workspaceId; the caller must be a workspace member.

gotchas.text: Only logs; nothing is sent.
It overwrites the protocol's public status text ('Protocolo enviado ao solicitante' / 'Falha ao enviar resposta ao solicitante' / 'Resposta ao solicitante pendente') and the intake deliveryStatus.
Every call adds a new receipt (no dedupe): do not retry a call that succeeded.
Any member, even a viewer, can call it.
The CLI cannot set attemptedAt/sentAt.

name: review_workspace_routing
purpose: Records the routing decision for a workspace intake entry (approve one project, split across projects, reject or defer) and, when approving, creates 'request' operational entries in the chosen project(s).
useWhen: The user/owner confirmed which project(s) should receive an intake entry
The user/owner decided to reject or defer an intake entry
avoidWhen: You only want suggestions -> preview_workspace_routing
The intake entry is already routed, rejected or deferred (see gotchas); ask a workspace admin to reopen it in the web app
Registering work directly in a known project without an intake entry -> create_operational_entry

inputs.notes: Firestore document ID.

inputs.source: get_protocol -> intakeEntryId (or user, from the web intake screen)
inputs.notes: Entry must be in status new or under_review.
enum approve-primary|split-projects|reject|defer. Any other value is silently treated as defer.
For approve-primary. Always pass it explicitly.
For split-projects: at least 2 distinct IDs; the first becomes the primary.
Stored on the intake entry.

preconditions: Caller is the workspace owner or an admin member
Intake entry status is new or under_review
The user/owner confirmed the decision, especially when preview outcome was ambiguous, multi-project or no-match
Selected projects belong to this workspace (the server does not check)
API key access: not exposed to OAuth connectors
returns: {id (routingDecisionId), workspaceId, intakeEntryId, outcome, reasonCode, confidence, rationale, candidates[], status approved|rejected|deferred, action, suggestedPrimaryProjectId, suggestedSecondaryProjectIds[], createdOperationalEntryIds[], reviewedBy, reviewedAt}

errors.when: You do not have permission to review workspace routing
errors.fix: Caller is not owner/admin; hand the decision to a workspace admin.

errors.when: Workspace intake entry not found
errors.fix: Get intakeEntryId from get_protocol(protocolCode) or ask the user.

errors.when: Approve-primary routing requires a selected project
errors.fix: Pass selectedProjectId from preview_workspace_routing candidates.

errors.when: Split-projects routing requires at least two selected projects
errors.fix: Pass at least 2 distinct selectedProjectIds.

errors.when: Invalid workspace intake status transition from <status> to <status>
errors.fix: The entry was rejected or deferred. Operational entries and a decision may ALREADY have been created: list them with list_operational_entries in the selected projects and report to the user; do not retry.

errors.when: Project <id> not found / You do not have access to this project
errors.fix: Use a projectId from preview_workspace_routing candidates. In split-projects, entries for earlier projects may already exist.

gotchas.text: Not idempotent and not transactional.
Calling it again on a 'routed' entry creates duplicate operational entries and a second decision; routed is final.
approve-primary without selectedProjectId takes the top preview candidate even when the outcome is no-match.
A typo in action (e.g. 'approve') silently defers the entry.
Status flow: new -> under_review (automatic) -> routed | rejected | deferred.
Created entries are type 'request' copies of the intake title/description, linked by sourceWorkspaceIntakeEntryId and sourceRoutingDecisionId.
split-projects ignores selectedProjectId.
selectedProjectId and selectedProjectIds are not checked against the preview candidates or the workspace: pass only a projectId from preview.candidates[] of the same workspace.

name: update_workspace_capability

Un-archiving a capability (set status 'active' or 'deferred')
avoidWhen: Archiving -> archive_workspace_capability
The capability does not exist yet -> create_workspace_capability
Owner-agent credential with preview/commit flow -> preview_owner_roadmap_change / commit_owner_roadmap_change (update_capability operation)

inputs.notes: Firestore document ID.
Use includeArchived=true to find archived ones.
If sent, must not be empty.
Empty string clears it.
enum active|deferred. 'archived' is rejected.
Empty string clears it; not checked against membership.
Array of strings; REPLACES the whole tag list; [] clears it.

preconditions: Caller is the workspace owner or an admin member
The capability exists in this workspace
The user asked for or approved the change
API key access: not exposed to OAuth connectors
returns: The full capability after the update: {id, workspaceId, name, description, status, ownerUserId, tags[], archivedAt, archivedBy, archiveReason, createdAt, createdBy, updatedAt, updatedBy}

errors.when: Workspace capability update has no changes.
errors.fix: Send at least one of name, description, status, ownerUserId, tags.

errors.fix: Send a non-empty name or omit the field.

errors.when: You do not have permission to manage this workspace roadmap

Not gated by roadmap governance enforce mode.

name: validate_workspace_context_completeness
purpose: Checks whether the workspace executive context is complete enough for assisted operation and returns a status, score, blockers, warnings, field issues and next actions.
useWhen: Checking only the context side (mandate, roles, policies) before letting agents act more autonomously
After an approved apply_workspace_context_update, to confirm blockers were removed
avoidWhen: You want one verdict combining completeness and project alignment -> generate_workspace_readiness_report
Only project ownership drift -> validate_workspace_project_alignment
The individual gap list -> list_workspace_context_gaps

inputs.notes: On an OAuth connector bound to a single workspace it may be omitted.

On OAuth connectors the grant has scope workspace:read
returns: {workspace, executiveContext, validation{validationType:'context-completeness', status complete|partial|blocked, score 0-100, blockers[gap], warnings[gap], issues[{field, severity, message}], nextActions[] (max 5)}, generatedAt}. validation is null when the context cannot be built.

errors.when: JSON-RPC -32003

gotchas.text: Every missing executive role is a blocker, so status stays 'blocked' until all 5 roles are assigned (workspace-owner is derived automatically from the owner membership; the other 4 need explicit assignment via apply_workspace_context_update).

nextActions are the gaps' Portuguese suggestedAction strings.
